name: acahti-saidc
description: Acahti git, PRs, pipelines, CI, and optional Work/Argos/Chat for your chosen instance.

interface.shortDescription: Acahti git, CI, and optional Work/Argos/Chat.
interface.longDescription: SAIDC workspace edition. MCP endpoint is preconfigured; each member supplies OAuth authorization through the client connection setup. Run the bundled setup skill after installation. Benchyard shell tasks use Secrets and CLI. Use MCP first for identity, repositories and CI. Read whoami.modules for optional Work/Argos/Chat. Optional trusted hooks provide author reminders.
defaultPrompt: 连接 Acahti：运行首次设置，验证我的身份和待办
使用 Acahti MCP 查看当前仓库的 PR 和流水线状态；若 modules.argos 开启，说明 Argos 运行入口
提交代码前通过 Acahti MCP 核验 Author，设置当前仓库的 Git 身份并检查 CI
